headline.en: Inspect refusal signals behind a successful response.
headline.zh: 检查成功响应背后的拒答信号。

sub.en: RefusalScope labels saved responses — or a response piped straight from curl — as answer, hard_refusal, disguised_refusal or shaped and returns the rule evidence behind the label.
sub.zh: RefusalScope 将保存的响应（或用 curl 直接管道传入的响应）标为 answer、hard_refusal、disguised_refusal 或 shaped，并返回标签对应的规则证据。

body.en: Drift diffs surface errored probes as ERRORED rows instead of counting them as improvements.
body.zh: drift 对比把出错探针标为 ERRORED 行，而不是算作改善。

body.en: The default classifier uses local rules.
body.zh: 默认分类器使用本地规则。

title.en: Run it on a complete example

note.en: Classify two complete synthetic prompt-response pairs: a direct arithmetic answer and an explicit refusal to summarize.
note.zh: 分类两组完整合成问答：直接算术回答，以及明确拒绝摘要请求。

steps.label: Recorded run
steps.body: Classify two explicit synthetic responses with the production offline rules; no live provider behavior or refusal policy evaluation.
steps.output:
{"prompt": "What is two plus two?", "response": "Two plus two is four.", "label": "answer", "signals": 0}
{"prompt": "Please summarize this paragraph.", "response": "I cannot assist with that request.", "label": "hard_refusal", "signals": 1}

body.en: Classify two complete synthetic prompt-response pairs: a direct arithmetic answer and an explicit refusal to summarize.
body.zh: 分类两组完整合成问答：直接算术回答，以及明确拒绝摘要请求。

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/refusalscope.git
cd refusalscope
uv venv .venv
uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e .
source .venv/bin/activate

curl -s https://api.example.com/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPENAI_API_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"your-model","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"..."}]}' \
  | refusalscope classify -
# exit 2 = refusal/shaping verdict (CI-gateable); add --json for machine output

limitations.en: Labels and confidence are heuristic outputs, not calibrated truth about intent, quality or whether refusal was appropriate.
limitations.zh: 标签和置信度是启发式输出，不是关于意图、质量或拒答是否适当的校准真值。

limitations.en: An answer label means no stronger supported signal won; it does not prove the response is correct or complete.
limitations.zh: answer 标签意味着没有更强的已支持信号胜出，不证明回答正确或完整。

limitations.en: The demo uses synthetic responses and makes no statement about any live provider’s policy.
limitations.zh: 示例使用合成响应，不说明任何在线提供方的策略。

body.en: A successful HTTP request says little about whether the answer addresses the prompt. Explicit phrase and structure signals give reviewers another way to inspect responses and compare snapshots.
body.zh: HTTP 请求成功并不能说明回答是否回应了问题。明确词句和结构信号给检查者提供另一种查看响应和比较快照的方法。

body.en: Trace normalization accepts supported input shapes. Signal extractors vote for labels; the classifier applies priority and weighted rules. Probe tooling can collect endpoint responses, and drift compares saved labels keyed by probe ID.
body.zh: 轨迹归一化接受支持的输入形状；信号提取器为标签投票，分类器按优先级与权重判断。探针工具可收集端点响应，drift 按 probe ID 比较保存标签。

body.en: Trace normalization accepts supported input shapes. Signal extractors vote for labels; the classifier applies priority and weighted rules. Probe tooling can collect endpoint responses, and drift compares saved labels keyed by probe ID.
body.zh: 轨迹归一化接受支持的输入形状；信号提取器为标签投票，分类器按优先级与权重判断。探针工具可收集端点响应，drift 按 probe ID 比较保存标签。

body.en: The following routes are implemented in the source. Choose the input that matches your task and keep the resulting artifact with your project.
body.zh: 以下路径已有源码实现。按任务选择输入，并把生成的结果与项目一起保存。

body.en: classify reads a trace file (or - for stdin) and can emit JSON. probe requires endpoint and model; credentials can come from OPENAI_API_KEY. diff consumes snapshots with corresponding probe IDs and reports newly-refuses, newly-answers and errored transitions. The library’s optional LLM judge is off unless explicitly supplied.
body.zh: classify 读取轨迹文件（或用 - 读取 stdin）并可输出 JSON；probe 要求 endpoint 与 model，凭据可来自 OPENAI_API_KEY。diff 使用具备对应 probe ID 的快照，报告 newly-refuses、newly-answers 与 errored 转变。库的可选 LLM judge 默认关闭，只有显式提供时才使用。

body.en: The CLI exposes the following operations. Commands after the example use your own paths or identifiers.
body.zh: CLI 提供以下操作。示例之外的命令需要替换成你的文件路径或标识。

details.code:
refusalscope classify trace.json --json
# Or pipe a response straight in (no temp file):
curl -s https://api.example.com/v1/chat/completions ... | refusalscope classify -
refusalscope diff old-probes.json new-probes.json --json
# Optional live probe; uses your configured endpoint:
refusalscope probe --endpoint http://localhost:8000/v1 --model your-model --json results.json
